name: MJN Services
pricing: 1.5% variable or 3% flat; $200 monthly minimum after 90 days
summary: Publishes a complete rate and fee schedule, with a variable rate that moves with how fast your shipper pays and a flat alternative.
differentiator: The most complete fee schedule we found: every line, including the ones others leave out, is on one page. The catch is the $200 minimum monthly fee after 90 days. At $5K a month in invoices the 3% flat rate comes to $150, so the minimum lifts the real cost to $200, or 4%.

terms.rate: Variable rate 1.5% (adjusts based on shipper payment timing); flat rate 3% (fixed for 60 days regardless of payment timing)
terms.contract: The initial contract period is 90 days
terms.minimum: $200/month, applies after 90 days; waived in months where calculated fees exceed this amount
terms.otherFees: Application fee, credit reporting fee and invoice processing fee: none. First 30 days free.
terms.speed: Invoices submitted by 1:00 PM MST receive same-day ACH

costModel.note: The 3% flat rate, with the $200 monthly minimum that applies after 90 days. The 1.5% variable rate depends on how fast each shipper pays.

bestFor: Carriers who want every fee in writing before signing.
skipIf: You factor under about $6,700 a month; the $200 minimum then costs more than 3%.
